conceptBeforeSelection.concept: Digital security, governance and cybercrime inquiry
conceptBeforeSelection.targetBasis: Cybersecurity is a socio-technical problem: technical operation and protection of networked systems, offending/victimisation and legal enforcement, organisational/public governance and evidence-based response. Build a programme-level closest challenge integrating these objects rather than a generic computer-science or social-science bundle.

candidateDirections.name: Digital security, governance and cybercrime inquiry
candidateDirections.role: Strongest closest response; defining target remains cyber threats and social/legal response.

candidateDirections.name: Cyber risk, public policy and organisational resilience
candidateDirections.role: Coherent core reorganisation, tested only after closest gate; generic management alone is insufficient.

candidateDirections.name: Technical systems and digital evidence
candidateDirections.role: Coherent technical/evidence reorganisation; ordinary software/machine-learning content does not establish attack/defence or forensic practice by itself.

conceptBeforeSelection.ownership: All16generator-eligible interests owned by defining multidisciplinary core; candidate directions reorganise them and do not invent extra interests or residual category.
conceptBeforeSelection.stopping: No accepted comparison or extra alternative before unresolved external30EC and full programme comparability are established. No three-slot target, no arbitrary four-course swaps, no final no-match from missing source/planning.

strongestPositive: This is an interdisciplinary social-science programme, not simply a hacking qualification. UCR actually teaches network/OS packet investigation, programming/software/algorithms, database authorization, general criminal and international/EU law, privacy/forensic-AI ethics, policy craft, digital publics, social psychology and empirical research. Calling Bullshit directly teaches misinformation/deepfake analysis and response. Organizational psychology provides actual culture/change, human-factor and research study. These are genuine academic connections, not merely transferable skills.

trialAssessment.positive: Full computing/law/social-method progression; new misinformation teaching strengthens the prior challenge. Actual network, criminal-law and misinformation inquiry retained.
trialAssessment.shortfall: The continued taught object remains general computing, law, AI ethics and digital society. It does not provide the confirmed cyber-specific explanatory and response progression across vulnerabilities/controls, offender platforms/victimology, digital investigative powers and incident lifecycle. A chosen cyber project cannot silently create these taught subjects.

trialAssessment.positive: Coherent shift toward organizational culture/change, leadership under pressure, original survey research, digital ethics and recipient-tested online/extremism prevention; retains real computing/law/misinformation. Five course changes follow that substantive priority.
trialAssessment.shortfall: Stronger organizational and prevention inquiry is valuable. Its actual cases and tools still do not establish security-control design, cybercrisis/incident response, cyber-victimology or digital investigative procedure as sustained study. It loses some algorithmic depth without resolving the thematic integration.

coreChallenge: A claimed comparison of the full confirmed first 120 EC would still include the known cyber-specific subjects and integrated ransomware study. Excluding the unknown final 30 cannot remove these already-known defining requirements. Narrowing instead to general programming/law/methods plus misinformation would carve away known core substance rather than offer a meaningful comparison of that core. No numerical coverage threshold is used.
stopping: No closest response passes material academic comparability. Two complete feasible research challenges test strongest reorganizations; no accepted Alternative 2/3 or canonical UCR schedule is created after the closest gate fails. Their 37.5-EC difference reflects actual priorities, not a target acceptance quota.
adverseTest: If the remaining 30 EC deepen specialist cyber study, the known shortfall persists without assuming any new unit. If they instead emphasize broad governance, ethics, organizations or accessible interdisciplinary research, give all those UCR connections full positive weight: they still do not remove the confirmed cyber-specific inquiry in the first 120. A correction to final-work format/access/weights changes full-degree certification, not this independent bounded negative.
